newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to up 0.100 cent. Further weakness seen in cash markets but futures looking oversold.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Index lower, corn seen higher and possible spillover from live cattle.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Carryover selling seen on Hog and Pig report concerns but stronger pork product market may provide support.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.250 to 1.000 cent. Carryover from limit losses and rising hog slaughter but looking oversold.
